scope: Independent review of all 12 new questions, criteria and contexts against the complete four cached evaluation extractions; copied development cases reviewed only for packaging and inherited limitations. No training, candidate inference, external calls, or bundle edits.

checks.target_models_or_hardware_not_present_in: Qwen and A5000 have zero occurrences in each complete cached evaluation extraction; nearby reported setup paragraphs were also inspected. This is evidence about these extractions, not all literature.

rows.notes: GQA divides query heads into G groups, each sharing one key/value head; G=1 is MQA and G equal to query-head count is MHA. Source c1 exactly supports both facts.

Mean pooling and public T5.1.1 starting checkpoints are supported. Main results use alpha=0.05 of original pretraining steps; the full source separately uses compute language in its abstract, so the explicit steps question and criterion correctly select the experimental definition.

Full cached source does not establish the Qwen3/A5000/two-reader target measurement. Revised f2 is conditional rather than demanding T5/encoder-decoder recitation. Final question and f3 ask an unexecuted next search for peak KV-cache footprint distinct from total VRAM, matching the existing report_gap channel.

W8A8 and the reciprocal per-channel activation/weight rescaling are supported. Although the displayed equation itself is omitted by the paragraph extractor, c2 states the inverse scaling relationship and the multiplication direction is a valid stated algebraic derivation preserving the linear layer.
Revised f1 now grades only the requested 512 random sentences from Pile. Alpha=0.5 for OPT/BLOOM and alpha=0.75 for GLM-130B are correctly bound in c1 and the full source.

The complete extraction establishes no Qwen3/A5000/two-reader latency measurement. Final question/f3 ask a next search for a matched latency and quality comparison, not an experiment proposal. Partial source results remain conditional and retain actual scope; a 1.56x headline cannot be transferred to this target.

Per-channel keys grouped across tokens, per-token values, and recent full-precision residual caches are supported by the full source and exact contexts. Revised f2 explicitly treats queue and group-threshold details as explanatory rather than additional required clauses, matching the question.

The full efficiency paragraph supports Llama-2-7B, one A100 80GB, mean prompt 161 and generated 338, and increasing batch size until OOM. No input/output reversal or numeric/baseline mismatch. ShareGPT provenance is useful context, not an additional question requirement.

Full source establishes no requested Qwen3/A5000/token/concurrency peak-VRAM measurement. Final f2 is conditional on offered partial results; final question/f3 ask a next search targeting total peak memory, correctly rejecting a cache-only compression factor as a target VRAM measurement.

Magnitude and direction are both fine-tuned in the main DoRA construction, with LoRA used for directional updates. Full source also studies selective update variants; the criteria describe the general construction and should not be read as asserting every later variant updates every component of every layer.

Detaching the dynamically updated directional norm from the gradient graph is supported. The 24.4% LLaMA-7B and 12.4% VL-BART reductions are correctly attributed to modified versus unmodified DoRA, not DoRA versus LoRA or full fine-tuning.

No exact Qwen3/A5000 DoRA-versus-LoRA training-VRAM reduction is established by the complete extraction. Conditional f2 preserves the modified-versus-unmodified DoRA comparator if its percentages are cited. Final question/f3 request an unexecuted next search for matched memory and quality evidence, matching report_gap.

inherited_and_split_limits: The 12 development questions were previously evaluated. Their copied references are exposed model-assisted development rubrics, not human gold or untouched evaluation.

The requested-facts-only protocol must govern overcomplete development reference strings; do not require irrelevant recitation or repetition of conditions already given in the question. Historical grades are unchanged by this audit.

Both development and final evaluation gaps request a next search. Optional partial findings retain actual source conditions; the report_gap channel and Unanswerable submission are reviewed jointly. The FlashAttention extracted self-comparison typo remains an inherited source limitation.
Paper-ID disjointness is verified within this bundle, not semantic/topic disjointness, training contamination absence, or certified pretraining disjointness.

All four new target gaps concern one later model/hardware family; these are useful scoped extrapolation and next-search checks but do not assess local experiment-design execution, broad abstention, or real-world compatibility performance.

The public bundle contains grader references and complete evaluation sources. The policy to keep them out of training/tuning is documented but not enforced by public files; the eventual runner must expose only assigned source/question fields.

Complete cached html_paragraphs extractions are the reviewed evidence boundary; equations, tables, or figures may be omitted. This audit does not certify complete original-paper rendering or independent author/human verification.
authorization: Preparation/source review only. No training, reinforcement-learning reward, paid run, or candidate inference was performed or authorized by this audit.
